digest.component_or_area: completion verifier wrapper and direct phase metrics
propositions: Direct monotonic timers across wrapper, attempt, handle-resolution, snapshot-context, inner-setup, dispatch, and finalization boundaries must partition the previously unattributed 237743.4 ms gap between verifier_call_ms and inner verifier total_ms without adding I/O, subprocess, network, retry, sleep, or lock instrumentation.

The hierarchical phase timings plus existing-work counts (attempt/resume/workflow-step) must reconcile verifier_call_ms to named child phases with maximum 1 ms discrepancy per phase and 10 ms cap, emitting any larger remainder explicitly as unattributed_verifier_ms without causal naming.

Existing llm_ms, det_ms, total_ms, request, tool-call, and consumption metrics must remain unchanged; instrumentation adds no I/O, file/tracker write, Git subprocess, or new sidecar emission beyond reusing COMPLETION_VERDICT.metrics payload.
Optional metrics collector must thread through existing call graph so callers without it remain unchanged and full instrumentation overhead remains below 50 microseconds per close in microbenchmark.
Model-backed PASS and FAIL sidecars must both directly attribute synchronous phases inside verifier_call_ms with no causal inference, preserving legacy duration probe rows.
